File:Enigmacursor TD.png.ImageDescription: Enigmacursor is a small basal ornithischian dinosaur that grew to about 1.5 m in length. Typical of early members of this group, it had a relatively long neck and a small head with a beak. The dense hips and long slender legs suggest Enigmacursor was well adapted for running, an essential trait that the small herbivore would have used to evade predators.
